declareSheet.declarationSaysWhichGroups: A declaration says which groups of this lens may use which. Add a second group first.
declareSheet.layerMayUseAny: A layer may use any layer below it; an import upward crosses the order. Leave a group out to judge it by pairs only.
declareSheet.eachCellRowUses: Each cell: row uses column, with the imports this snapshot has. Click to set it: forbidden, allowed, then back to the layers' say.
declareSheet.allowExactlyWhatBuild: Allow exactly what the build files declare between {manifestGroupsSize} groups named for modules, and forbid the rest
declareSheet.groupsNotLayersOnly: {outOfLayersLength} of {groupListLength} groups are not in the layers ({value}{value2}): only pairs judge them.
declareSheet.snapshotWouldCrossDeclaration: {imports} in this snapshot would cross this declaration.
declareSheet.nothingSnapshotCrossesDeclaration: Nothing in this snapshot crosses this declaration.

rulesExport.saveDeclarationArchstatsRules: Save this declaration as archstats-rules.yml: archstats assert runs it on every build and fails, with file and line, when an import crosses it
rulesExport.declareDependenciesLensFirst: Declare dependencies on this lens first
rulesExport.copyGithubActionsJob: Copy a GitHub Actions job that runs the saved rules

rules.declaredRulesWhatBreaks: The declared rules and what breaks them: each rule's status and the imports against it.
rules.snapshotHasNoRule: This snapshot has no rule results.

noneRulesEngineChecks.one: The {count} rule the engine checks does not apply to this codebase ({names}), and no rules of its own are declared.
noneRulesEngineChecks.other: None of the {count} rules the engine checks apply to this codebase ({names}), and no rules of its own are declared.

rules.declaredManifestNoImport: Declared in a manifest with no import in the source
rules.importedTypesOnlyErased: Imported for its types only; erased when the program runs
rules.namedStringResolvedRuntime: Named by a string and resolved at runtime
rules.ordinaryImportSource: An ordinary import in the source
rules.noRulesEngineChecks: None of the rules the engine checks apply to this codebase, and no rules of its own are declared.

rulesAsCode.layersTopFirstPair: Layers, top first: {order}. {pairsLength} pair rule(s); anything else {value}.
rulesAsCode.githubWorkflowsArchitectureYml:
# .github/workflows/architecture.yml
name: Architecture
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  rules:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with: { go-version: "1.24" }
      - run: go install github.com/archstats/archstats@latest
      - run: archstats assert --rules archstats-rules.yml -f .
